decisions.reason: Extending automatic placeholder clearing to Vejledning and Bestyrelsesseminar does not necessarily extend the separate requirement that placeholder text serve as a visible input cue.
The date-selector scope change in message 238 comes from separate date-function clauses and is already represented; the placeholder-clearing scope change does not alter it.
Multiline entry and manual line-break support are independent of whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The source decision does not change the checklist control type or its scope.
The source expands clear-on-activation behavior but does not require the robust replacement for password-dependent legacy fields to be used in additional documents.
The source decision does not alter the dropdown control or its Bestyrelsesmode scope.
Automatic placeholder clearing does not change the independent requirement to preserve title-field formatting.
The source decision changes placeholder-clearing scope but does not modify help-label text, placement, hover behavior, or the existing all-control-fields scope.
The continuous-text spacing requirement arises from separate line-break clauses in message 238 and is unaffected by the placeholder-clearing scope change.
Text wrapping and column displacement are separate layout behaviors already addressed by their own same-message Event; placeholder clearing does not modify them.
The fixed-margin requirement comes from a separate Vejledning clause and remains unchanged by the expansion of placeholder-clearing behavior.
The source decision does not change automatic bullet continuation when Enter is pressed.
